queries.english: Who is holding another person off the ground?
queries.chinese: 此刻正托着另一个人、让对方双脚离地的人。

queries.english: Who has held another person off the ground at any point so far?
queries.chinese: 从视频开始到现在，曾托起另一个人使其双脚离地的人；放下后仍算。

queries.english: Who was supporting the child when the child took a shot at the basket?
queries.chinese: 孩子投篮时，是谁托着孩子？

queries.english: Who has supported the child on their shoulders without a break since the video began?
queries.chinese: 谁从视频开始就一直让孩子坐在自己肩上，中间没有放下？

queries.english: Segment the people that have not held another person off the ground so far.
queries.chinese: 截至当前尚未满足原 EVER 所述动作条件的可见同类实例。

events.title: 托起孩子投篮后放下
events.criterion: 用身体或手臂托住另一个人，使对方双脚离开地面时开始；对方有脚重新落地时结束。自己跳起、互相拥抱但双脚仍在地上不算。选择抱起别人的人，不选被抱起的人。
